concepts.proposed_markdown: The refreshed contract-edit schema exposes feature-gated Stripe `payment_gate_config` when adding a subscription. A subscription-linked recurring commit or credit can choose `BILLING_PERIOD_PAID`, which releases each child balance after payment for that billing period, or `INITIAL_BILLING_PERIOD_PAID_ONLY`, which releases all child balances after the first payment. The page does not define payment-state authority, failure and retry behavior, pending-balance visibility, revocation, concurrency, or Stripe reconciliation. [[source-metronome-api-reference-contracts-edit-a-contract]]
warnings: Both fields are feature-gated in the OpenAPI snapshot; do not generalize them to every account.
